# dogg-api — bounded static JSON over native DOGG

The native chains at https://github.com/kody-w/dogg are the record. This
repository is a non-authoritative `dogg/0-static-api` convenience projection,
not RAPP/1.

- Latest world state: `api/latest.json`
- Bounded rolling series: `api/series/<source>.json`
- Directory and coverage: `api/index.json`
- Raw base: `https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kody-w/dogg-api/main/`

Profile `dogg/0-static-api-provenance/1` binds every row to its full native
world tuple, immutable source commit/path/line/raw bytes, and the exact verified
tick tuple referenced by the world payload. `spine_head` is a deprecated alias
of that referenced tick hash, never an independently newer head.

Verify provenance against the immutable commit named in each document. Series
coverage states the rolling limit, returned range, total matching rows, and
omitted count; complete history remains in the native DOGG chain.
